text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... whew. Alright, five-minute 
break...

text_block_list.name: Girl with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! You're Narita Taishin-san, 
right...!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh... Yeah, but... Who are you?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"I'm... a huge fan of yours! 
Taishin-san!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, ahh... I see... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry for calling out to you so 
suddenly. But... I really wanted to say 
thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...'Thank you'?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because I wear big glasses, people 
used to tease me about it a lot...

text_block_list.name: Girl with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Taishin-san made me want to give it 
my all too. ...I realized I couldn't just 
let people keep looking down on me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the other day was the first time 
I stood up and told them to stop looking 
down on me... That's why I wanted to say 
thank you—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...No. That has nothing to do with me 
anyway."

text_block_list.name: Girl with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah, r-right, of course. I'm sorry 
for springing that on you out of 
nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...You're the one who found the courage 
to refuse being made a fool of, aren't 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Then keep at it just like that, so you can 
stand tall and be proud of who you are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Regardless of others... or even me.

"That day, a single fan letter arrived 
addressed to Narita Taishin."

However, the contents were slightly 
different—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Cheering for you on my own terms"... I 
see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Haha. Look who's talking.
